note: Primary defect claim from the issue: with SomeBitfield declared as { SomeEnum field1 : 2; uint32_t rest : 30; } (enum bitfield first), '(SomeBitfield)0' is rejected with this exact diagnostic quoted in the issue body. Anchored on the literal diagnostic text (quote_from-eligible) rather than a generic 'cannot convert' regex, because the issue's own symptom IS this diagnostic (see step 6 note on diagnostic-quality issues: markers must not demote a probe whose reported symptom is itself the diagnostic). The reordered struct (control-reordered.hlsl, 'uint32_t rest : 30; SomeEnum field1 : 2;') is expected --expect no-match: the reporter says the same cast compiles cleanly once the fields are swapped, which is the order-dependence this issue is about.
